feat.description: A plan step that delivers behaviour for a ticket

refactor.description: Pure refactoring on green, no behaviour change

test.description: Adding or correcting tests on their own

docs.description: Workflow artifacts (ticket, plan, review) and documentation

chore.description: Repository maintenance, tooling, or dependency bumps

scopes.<ticket-id>: The ticket being worked on, matching the feature/<ticket-id> or fix/<ticket-id> branch
scopes.release: Promoting develop to main (merge main into develop, release PR)
scopes.repo: Root configuration, tooling, and workflow setup outside a ticket

BREAKING CHANGE.description: The commit introduces a breaking change

Closes.description: Closes a tracking issue or pull request
